name: Grep
description:
[MCP:peri] Search file contents using regex.

Directory walks skip hidden entries and honor ignore rules; an explicit file path bypasses those exclusions. A saved result contains only collected output, not necessarily all matches; narrow or partition the search for complete counts.

Output modes: Match lines, matching files, matching-line counts by file in single-line mode (not occurrences), or nonmatching files. The limit counts output lines in content mode and files otherwise; zero removes only the count limit, not the byte cap.

path.description: File or directory to search; defaults to cwd.

glob.description: File name glob filter, such as *.rs. Matches the base name only; use path to scope directories.

type.description: File type filter, such as rust or ts.

output_mode.description: Result format: content (default), files_with_matches, count, or files_without_matches.

context.description: Context lines before and after each match.

after_context.description: Context lines after each match; overrides context on that side.

before_context.description: Context lines before each match; overrides context on that side.

show_line_numbers.description: Include line numbers; defaults to true.

multiline.description: Allow matches across lines; . matches newlines and ^/$ match line boundaries.

head_limit.description: Output cap: lines with context, or files in file modes. Default 250; 0 removes only the count cap.

offset.description: Skip this many output entries before applying head_limit.
